title: NXS hub manifest (hub.yaml)
description: The hub's index: its own chips (the deserializer and the serializer), the flows module that composes a port from them and the deserializers it serves, the default wiring, and the golden references its composer is diffed against. Cam personalities are not the hub's: every installed one is offered on its links.

api.description: The hub manifest API this SDK speaks; the loader refuses any other by name.

flows.description: The flow-assembly module (a .py file) or package (a directory with __init__.py), relative to the hub.
